text:
sasha: T-minus 30m prelaunch safety sweep — quick checklist: pins set? smoke results? rollback owner assigned? release notes final? any DB migrations pending? Reply with ✅ when green.

deploybot: deploybot here. Canary started on cluster-prod-canary — id canary-171300. To pin/unpin: `/ops pin <service> <version>` or `/ops unpin <service>`. I will post updates as traffic ramps.

mike: Pins: edge-proxy pinned to v2.3.1 by @mike (reason: last-minute config tweak).

priya: Smoke results: `make smoke` ran on canary — all checks green, 95p latency within SLO. Logs/summary: https://s3.redwoodinference/smoke/171300

reza: Rollback owner here. If we need to rollback I’ll execute fast-unpin + traffic-shift to previous stable and monitor.

linh: Release notes updated in GH: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/commits/171300 — added migration notes, feature flags, and known issues. No destructive DB migrations.

sasha: @infra-bot can you confirm infra quotas and GPU slot status for T0->T+15?

infra-bot: GPU capacity check: reserved 12/12 slots available, autoscaler warmup triggered. No quota alerts. :rocket:

mike: Can we hold all non-critical merges until T+30?

priya: Affirmative — holding PRs. Turning off experimental flag `ff/nerf-experimental`.

deploybot: Final pin checklist (run these before ramp):
```
/ops pin frontend v5.2.0
/ops pin backend v5.2.0-dbcompatible
/ops pin embeddings-service v3.4.9
```

maya: Oncall handoff done. PagerDuty runbook linked: https://runbooks/launch-handoff. I’m standing by for alerts.

sasha: All checks ✅ from me. Ramp plan: T+0 -> 5% traffic, T+5 -> 25%, T+15 -> 100%. Abort criteria: error rate > 0.8% for 5m or latency regressions > 2x. If abort, @reza will run rollback procedure.

mike: Monitoring dashboards live — I’ll call abort if I see the threshold.

reza: Ready to execute rollback: steps are unpin frontend/backend, `deploybot emergency-shift previous`, kill canary pods if needed.

deploybot: Canary at 100 users, beginning scheduled ramp per plan. I’ll post progress updates and final status.

sasha: Last call for release note edits or launch exceptions within 10m.

linh: No more changes.

sasha: GO for launch. :thumbsup:

deploybot: Deploy started — logging at https://deploys.redwoodinference/job/171300. Command invoked: `deploybot start --canary canary-171300 --plan ramp-5-25-100`. I will report back on each milestone.
